name: agent-sidekick
description: Registers the agent-sidekick MCP server (sidekick_run, sidekick_dispatch, sidekick_workflow, sidekick_steckbrief, sidekick_backends, sidekick_status, and more) for an already installed agent-sidekick binary, plus a skill on when to delegate

binary.title: agent-sidekick executable
binary.description: Command or absolute path of the agent-sidekick binary. Keep the default if agent-sidekick is on the PATH that Claude Code sees; otherwise enter the absolute path (e.g. %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\agent-sidekick\agent-sidekick.exe expanded, or ~/.local/bin/agent-sidekick expanded).
